id: title:jakesciotto:tunnel framer websocket through the egress proxy

review.posthog_relevance: Supports warehouse ingestion connectivity for Framer and other warehouse sources when HTTP(S) proxies are configured, enabling the ingestion pipeline to establish secure WebSocket connections through proxy environments.
review.reason: Adds HTTP proxy support and custom CONNECT tunnel implementation to the warehouse ingestion layer, allowing connections to proceed through proxy configurations while preserving TLS compatibility. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement for warehouse ingestion reliability.
review.uncertainty: While the code change is clear, the actual benefit depends on the deployment environment having HTTP proxies and the warehouse ingestion being actively used; no production incident or adoption is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are inferred. No tier assignment is performed.

observations.behavior: Adds HTTP proxy support and a custom CONNECT tunnel implementation.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion from Framer to proceed when an HTTP(S) proxy is configured, while preserving TLS and compatibility with goproxy-based egress proxies that return HTTP/1.0 200 OK.

observations.behavior: Adds a helper to establish a CONNECT tunnel through an HTTP(S) proxy and return the socket.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides the underlying socket connection that the websocket client uses, bypassing websockets' own proxy handling while retaining TLS and compatibility with HTTP/1.0 responses.
